name: classic-city-core/stat-comparison
title: Stat Comparison
description: One before → after figure set beside the sentence that explains it: “14.3% → 79.1%”, then a heading and a paragraph of context. The arrow is decorative — the pair is announced to screen readers as a single “from X to Y” label. Surface color comes from the block-level color picker; the border auto-derives to that color's palette partner (its “alt”).
